volume._why: LinkedIn publishes no message cap for 1st-degree connections, and §8.2 of its User Agreement bans automated sending. Ramp up, keep jitter, and pause on any warning. See PLAYBOOK.md §7.

sequence._why: 3 touches. Backlinko (12M emails): one follow-up = +65.8% replies. More than 3 unanswered DMs reads as spam.

track_mix._why: Share of NEW first-touches per day. Unused share rolls over to the next track in this order.
